title: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 4: Utunzaji wa maliasili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses -ki- for a condition or "while" (akifika, tutaondoka) and -ka- for actions that follow one another after a -li- verb (alifika akaketi).
representations: a chain of actions on cards
steps: Is it a condition or a chain?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika "Ukisoma utafaulu", -ki- inaonyesha nini?" Kwa nini "kufuatana" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Alifika akaketi", -ka- inaonyesha nini?" Kwa nini "sharti" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kamilisha: Aliamka ___oga." Kwa nini "akioga" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Matendo yanayofuatana baada ya -li- huchukua -ka-: akaoga, akavaa.
